workload.title: W2b's traffic on 2, 4 and 6 cores, and on 2 guaranteed + 2 burstable cores next to a batch job
workload.ladder: Q2: how ordering's gain changes with core count, and whether hint-aware ordering changes how the IOKernel grants burstable cores (the congestion signal is the oldest queued thread's age)

calibration.iters_per_us_note: loadgen --calibrate 100 --fakework sqrt on the server node, clock pinned at 2.4 GHz (performance governor, no turbo): 31899, 31900, 31899 iterations per 100 us
calibration.testbed_note: server and client on one node (hp070), IOKernel "ias noht" with loopback: control core 0, dataplane core 1, server and client kthreads on cores 2-9 with no shared hyperthreads; clock pinned at 2.4 GHz
calibration.handler_us_note: mean handler start-to-end time per nominal service time, measured in place (results/cal-handler/cal, fifo, 20k req/s, 2 repeats, Segments svc); rho = rate x mean handler time / cores
